item.title: Parking bay layout, 17th September
item.description:
There have been 2 electric parking bays painted/installed in the past week. They have been poorly spaced and this leaves a very small gap between the ‘electric vehicle parking only’ bay and my H-bar in front of my driveway. This means anything bigger than a smart car overhangs my driveway and makes it very difficult to see oncoming traffic and reduces my turning circle. In the week or so they’ve been painted, this has been an issue multiple times a day and requires remarking or a double yellow line for the small gap between the bay and the H-Bar

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 53, Harefield Road, Brockley, Greater London
